board.note: 21x21 hex grid. No fixed starting positions; pieces are placed adjacently to form a connected hive. Center cell (10,10) is the conventional first-move location. Stacking is unlimited to support beetles climbing on top of other pieces.

queen_bee.note: Moves exactly 1 step. Must be placed by turn 4.

beetle.note: Moves 1 step. Can climb on top of the hive (stacking). While on top, pins the piece below. Can move to occupied or empty cells.

grasshopper.note: Jumps in a straight line over one or more contiguous pieces, landing on the first empty cell beyond. Cannot jump over gaps.

soldier_ant.note: Slides any number of steps around the outside edge of the hive. Cannot pass through gaps too narrow to slide through (freedom of movement). Most mobile piece.

spider.note: Slides exactly 3 steps around the outside edge of the hive. Cannot backtrack or revisit cells during the move.

constraints: piece must be adjacent to at least one hive piece (except first piece of game)
after turn 1, piece must not be adjacent to any opponent piece

queen_placement_deadline.definition: each player must place their queen bee by their 4th turn
queen_placement_deadline.constraint: if queen is not placed by start of turn 4, player must place queen this turn

one_hive_rule.definition: the hive must remain a single connected group at all times
one_hive_rule.constraint: a piece cannot move if removing it would disconnect the hive

freedom_of_movement.definition: a piece can only slide between two cells if it can physically fit through the gap
freedom_of_movement.constraint: both cells adjacent to the movement path cannot both be occupied (sliding gate)

no_move_before_queen.definition: a player cannot move any piece until their queen bee has been placed
no_move_before_queen.constraint: move actions require queen on board

stacking.definition: only beetles can climb on top of other pieces
stacking.constraint: beetle on top pins the piece below (pinned piece cannot move)
